verdict.rationale: turbopuffer has a dedicated backups doc describing fully server-side namespace copies that work across regions and cloud providers, backed by a monitorable `copy_from_namespace` operation and instant copy-on-write branching. Together these give a first-party way to snapshot a namespace (its equivalent of a collection) into a backup copy. missing for 10: an explicitly documented restore workflow (restoring is only implied by copying back), named or point-in-time snapshot semantics, retention or scheduling of backups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
